newsitem.title: USA: American's pilots board approves labor contract.
newsitem.headline: American's pilots board approves labor contract.

text.p: The board of American Airlines' pilots union voted Friday to approve a labor contract proposed by the nation's second-largest air carrier, union officials said.

The five-year agreement includes a 9 percent wage increase, a stock option program and a guarantee that furloughed pilots will be tapped to fly new jets the carrier is buying for its American Eagle regional airline.
